task.name: Online bin packing
task.description: Write a Python priority(item, bins) function that scores each bin with enough remaining capacity; each arriving item goes to the highest-scoring bin. Scored by mean percent excess of bins used over the L1 lower bound on five generated Weibull sequences of 1000 items with capacity 100 (lower is better).
task.contract: priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray of one score per bin with enough remaining capacity; the item goes to the highest-scoring bin (FunSearch/EoH contract). Score: mean excess over the L1 lower bound in percent
